name: powershell_process_image_snapshot
command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Sort-Object ProcessId | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"

name: powershell_platform_static_inventory
command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "'### COMPUTER'; Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object Manufacturer,Model,HypervisorPresent,NumberOfLogicalProcessors,NumberOfProcessors,TotalPhysicalMemory | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; '### PROCESSOR'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,Manufacturer,Description,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors,ProcessorId,Family,VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled,L2CacheSize,L3CacheSize | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; '### PHYSICAL MEMORY'; Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Select-Object DeviceLocator,Capacity,Speed,ConfiguredClockSpeed,Manufacturer,PartNumber,SMBIOSMemoryType | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; '### MEMORY ARRAY'; Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemoryArray | Select-Object MemoryDevices,MaxCapacity,Location,Use | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; '### OS'; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; '### POWER PLAN'; powercfg.exe /getactivescheme; '### PROCESSOR POWER SETTINGS'; powercfg.exe /qh SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR; '### GPU INVENTORY ONLY'; Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name,AdapterRAM,DriverVersion | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"

name: powershell_pdh_processor_counter_catalog
command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-Counter -ListSet * -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.CounterSetName -match 'Processor Information|Processor'} | Select-Object CounterSetName,Counter | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"

name: powershell_counter_tools_readonly_availability
command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "'### VTUNE COMMAND'; Get-Command vtune.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source,Path | Format-List; '### SEP COMMAND'; Get-Command sep.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source,Path | Format-List; '### PCM COMMANDS'; Get-Command pcm-memory.exe,pcm-raw.exe,pcm.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source,Path | Format-List; '### WHERE PCM IN PATH'; where.exe pcm-memory.exe; where.exe pcm-raw.exe; '### PCM FILES IN STANDARD C INSTALL ROOTS'; where.exe /r 'C:\Program Files' pcm*.exe; where.exe /r 'C:\Program Files (x86)' pcm*.exe; where.exe /r 'C:\ProgramData' pcm*.exe; '### PCM UNINSTALL'; $roots=@('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*'); Get-ItemProperty $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.DisplayName -match 'Intel.*PCM|Performance Counter Monitor'} | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallLocation | Format-List"

name: stage2_background_before
command:
C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$processes = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
$samples = Get-Counter -Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval 1 -MaxSamples 11
$cpu = @($samples | ForEach-Object { $_.CounterSamples | Select-Object Timestamp,InstanceName,CookedValue,Status })
[ordered]@{ captured_utc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); cpu_counter='\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'; sample_interval_seconds=1; expected_samples=11; cpu_samples=$cpu; processes=$processes } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
"

h0_preflight_h0_official_20261011
command:
C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$pw=(powercfg.exe /getactivescheme | Out-String)
$pm=[regex]::Match($pw,'[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}')
$cpu=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
$lp=(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).NumberOfLogicalProcessors
$chrome0=@(Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id)
$samples=@()
for($i=0;$i -lt 11;$i++){$r=Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor -Filter \\\"Name='_Total'\\\";$samples += [pscustomobject]@{utc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');cpu=$r.PercentProcessorTime};if($i -lt 10){Start-Sleep -Seconds 1}}
$chrome1=@(Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id)
$mean=($samples|Measure-Object cpu -Average).Average;$max=($samples|Measure-Object cpu -Maximum).Maximum
[ordered]@{power_guid=if($pm.Success){$pm.Value.ToLowerInvariant()}else{''};cpu_names=$cpu;logical_processors=$lp;chrome_before=$chrome0;chrome_after=$chrome1;cpu_samples=$samples;mean_cpu_percent=$mean;max_cpu_percent=$max}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
"
